decision_contract.accept_only_if: The current official source explicitly states a positive USD-M Futures trading-fee reduction for paying fees with BNB, the retained current official API index independently exposes signed status lookup and a separate state-changing toggle, and the scope is limited to independently justified organic BTC ETH or SOL USD-M flow whose exact positive standard commission remains larger after every BNB acquisition holding residual and reconciliation cost.
fail_closed_if: the current official page does not contain every required term
the discount is not explicitly applicable to Futures trading fees
the required BNB would be acquired or retained before an independently justified organic trade exists
account eligibility exact symbol commission actual discount or realized fee payment is inferred from public sources
prohibited: creating enlarging churning or rerouting volume for the discount
using the discount to rescue an otherwise unprofitable trade
enabling or disabling BNB fee burn without separate explicit state-change authority

required_text_casefolded: futures: fees are charged in the margin asset

required_identities: POST /fapi/v1/feeBurn - Toggle BNB Burn On Futures Trade (TRADE)
